text: The rule-space covariance-extension classification: openness-level patterns are automatically achiral (all 64 two-letter colorings proper-equivalent to their P-images); chirality first appears at three condition values (exactly one chiral pair at k = 3, Burnside 57 - 56); at k = 4 there are exactly TWENTY chiral pairs (Burnside 240 - 220) with the oriented frame the canonical carrier; the antilinear value twist pairs odd with odd (Re R0 = 0 identically); and a chiral fixed rule costs exactly the one orientation bit shared with the theta seed. July kernel/semigroup/admissibility-era docs note, personally read in full 2026-09-04; released to the archive tier behind the lane memo - the note stays the primary surface of its own result. LIVE RESIDUALS (carried; this note is the primary threshold/carrier statement for the FRONT alphabet-exclusion campaign): physical alphabet identification - how many neighbor contents the fixed rule distinguishes - and the chirality route accounting (any chiral-rule proposal pays the oriented-frame channel + one orientation-odd bit). EPOCH: the note predates the 2026-08-05 Admissibility revision and quotes the pre-revision availability wording; read availability as distribution support.

The clause-mapping note: R*'s two clauses were direct instances of the then-current Record text - the additivity half rested on 'scalar readout I is additive', which the 2026-08-13 revision REMOVED from Record (that half now needs a fresh finite-additivity supplier; the content-determination half and the D-totality/law-sentence mapping survive) (with the exclusion direction witnessed on a finite choice orbit), and D-totality is the law sentence applied to a rule's stated domain - grounding the walls-attack ladder's two readings in axiom text without adjudicating the pointwise-domain question. The Qualification licensing diagnostic: in the six-direction finite model (a witness-level diagnostic; the note itself disclaims a universal classification of all admissibility laws), a chiral rule branch consumes exactly one unfixed reflection-odd bit (the J2 channel), which the landed 2026-07-04 clarification ('a law may not depend on a choice not fixed by the supplied structure, unless admitted') licenses only via a supplied source - while the state stays free to carry handedness (achiral law, chiral configuration reachable with mirror history equally reachable); explicitly weaker than a mirror axiom and not a theta = 0 claim. The v1 defect and v2 CANDIDATE repair (v2 is an unregistered candidate premise; N1-N3 are conditional on it and no claim is made that v2 is approved framework content): graded_constraint v1 is defective under mixed support (an unavailable element cannot be both unavailable and a normalized menu alternative); v2 conditions the full-lattice grading on the Admissibility support with the zero-total boundary explicit; N1-N3 prove coexistence, the conditioning channel, and the narrow record interface - w stays auxiliary until a bridge relates it to the distribution (2026-08-05 scope notes carried).
